Total equity attributable to equity holders of company 1,650,624 1,818,472 1,532,958 1,614,352 Non-controlling interest 257,335 316,338 - - Total Equity 1,907,959 2,134,810 1,532,958 1,614,352 Commentary The 1st half of the year was very challenging to our industry due to market and supply chain disruptions presented by the effects of COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these challenges, group revenues improved by 8% attributed to volume growth. Cost saving initiatives, through Total Performance Management (TPM), continue to yield positive gains with reduction in overall expenses by 12%. The completion of debt restructure has enabled the group to focus on brand equity building, market coverage and internal efficiency improvement. Dividend The directors do not recommend payment of an interim dividend. Outlook Due to COVID-19 pandemic, the construction sector is still running cautiously with lower than normal demand. This is however expected to rebound as the restrictions continue to be lifted and movement of goods and people resumes. Our subsidiary in Tanzania has continued to underperform due to challenges in accessing working capital and this remains a key focus area for the Board and Management. Despite the challenges experienced in the 1st half of the year, the Group continues to proactively identify pockets of opportunities to promote brand visibility and improve customer experience to expand its market share. The Board is confident that the collective effort of all stakeholders in our business will yield positive results. By Order of the Board Virginia Ndunge Company Secretary Nairobi, 28th August 2020
